title: Roof Inspections in McAllen, TX | Edel Roofing & Construction
description: Free roof inspections in McAllen, TX for home buyers, sellers, and owners with an aging roof. Written report the same visit. Call (956) 422-3335.
lede: Edel Roofing & Construction inspects roofs for McAllen homeowners, buyers, sellers, and property managers. The inspection is free, and you get a written report the same visit.

sections.title: A roof inspection, plainly explained
paras: We get on the roof and look at it up close. That means the shingles or membrane, the flashing at walls and chimneys, the vents and pipe boots, the valleys, and the edges. From that we can tell you how much life the roof has left and what needs work now versus later.
You get a written summary of what we found, with photos, not just a verbal opinion. Most residential inspections take 30 to 45 minutes on site, and we go over the results with you before we leave.

sections.title: Why McAllen roofs are worth checking
paras: McAllen's homes are older on average than its neighbors'. Census survey data (ACS 2024) puts the median McAllen home at 1997, compared with 2000 in Mission and 2002 in Edinburg, and about 40% of McAllen homes were built before 1990. A shingle roof here lasts roughly 20 to 25 years. So a McAllen house you are looking at may be on its second roof already, or still on an original roof that is near the end.

Many roofs that are near the end do not look it from the street. The shingles lie flat and the color is fine, but up close they are brittle, the granules are worn thin, and the flashing sealant has cracked. An inspection is the only way to know which kind of roof you have.

sections.title: When McAllen homeowners call for an inspection

cards.title: Buying a house
cards.body: Know the roof's age and condition before you close, so a roof replacement does not surprise you a year later.

cards.title: Selling a house
cards.body: A written report before you list lets you fix small items on your schedule instead of after the buyer's inspection.

cards.title: Insurance renewal
cards.body: If your insurer asks about the roof, a written report shows its actual condition, not just its age.

cards.title: After a storm
cards.body: Hail and wind damage often can't be seen from the ground. See storm damage in McAllen.

cards.title: A stain or a drip
cards.body: Something on the ceiling or a shingle in the yard. We find the cause and tell you what it takes to fix.

cards.title: Rental and commercial property
cards.body: Owners and managers who want the roof checked on a schedule, with a report for their records.

sections.title: Roof age and your insurance
paras: The Texas Department of Insurance says insurers cannot refuse or drop a homeowners policy because of roof age alone, but they can look at the roof's condition. Some policies pay older roofs at actual cash value, which subtracts depreciation from a claim. A written inspection report gives you something specific to show your agent when the roof comes up.

sections.title: What you get from an Edel inspection

proof.label: No charge and no obligation to hire us
A report with photos you can keep, share, or send to your insurer
Licensed, bonded, and insured roofing contractor

faqs.q: Should I get a roof inspection before buying a house in McAllen?
faqs.a: Yes, especially if the house was built before 2000. A full shingle replacement on a typical McAllen home generally runs $8,000 to $18,000, and that is better to know before you close than after.

faqs.q: Isn't the home inspector's report enough?
faqs.a: A home inspector looks at the whole house. A roofer spends the whole visit on the roof and can tell you how many years it has left and what a repair or replacement would involve.
Yes. If we find something that needs work, you get a written estimate, and there is no pressure to go ahead.
Most homes take 30 to 45 minutes on the roof. We walk you through what we found before we leave.

faqs.q: How do I schedule an inspection in McAllen?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. Our office is about 11 minutes from McAllen City Hall.
